name: cracked-windscreen

references.role: our approved tipper truck seen from directly above: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only; its windscreen is the thin dark strip at the front of the cab roof

art_plan.item: the cracked-glass overlay (docs/development/vehicle-glass.md, VG11), laid by script onto each of our vehicles' windscreen strip and shown by the damage looks while the glass is cracked or gone
art_plan.size: drawn wide at 3:1 and scaled down by script to each windscreen strip (about 220 x 15 px on the tipper's 512 px body)
art_plan.this_request: the pilot (owner's card, 23 Nov 2026: one vehicle first, then the rest), two attempts; one master serves every vehicle

prompt:
TOP-DOWN GAME OVERLAY. Camera directly above, looking straight down, as on Image 1.

Create an ORIGINAL texture for a game: a long, thin strip of a truck's windscreen glass seen from directly above, badly cracked: dark blue-grey tinted glass crossed by bright white star-shaped impact cracks and long branching fracture lines, the glass still in one piece. Image 1 is our approved truck: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only; do NOT draw the truck.

Draw ONLY the cracked glass strip, filling the canvas from edge to edge, with a thin near-black outline along its long edges. Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: soft flat cel shading, bold clean crack lines that still read when shrunk to a strip 15 pixels tall, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No truck, no frame, no wipers, no people, text, letters, numbers or logos.
